_comment: One worked example of a token the verifier ACCEPTS while the pin has been set to
HS256 (the deliberately misconfigured server described in instruction.md section 2).
Both configured keys are reproduced below. They are different on purpose: exactly
one of them is the key this signature was produced with, and the signed input is
likewise one of a small number of obvious candidates built from the two segments.
signature_b64 = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(<one of the keys>, <the signing input>)).
Recover both by computation; there is only one combination that reproduces it.
